events.title: SheReads: May Meet Up (Book Club)
events.description: Join the SheReads book club for their May meetup to discuss literature, share insights, and connect with fellow readers in a community-oriented setting.

events.title: Brisbane Social and Language Exchange
events.description: A welcoming social event designed for people to meet diverse individuals, practice different languages, engage in cultural exchange, and make new friends through conversation.

events.title: Three Storytellers, One Piano
events.description: Experience an intimate collaborative performance featuring spoken word storytelling alongside live piano accompaniment in a unique gallery setting, blending narrative and music.

events.title: Beginners Sourdough Workshop
events.description: Learn the traditional art of sourdough bread making in this hands-on workshop, covering techniques from starter maintenance to baking your first loaf.

events.title: AI & Society | Run Walk Coffee Club
events.description: Combine outdoor activity with intellectual discussion at this club that mixes running or walking with coffee and conversations about artificial intelligence and its impact on society.

events.title: Brisbane Street Art Festival 2026
events.datetime: Sun 17 May, 9:00 AM - 12:00 PM (also other dates)
events.description: Explore Brisbane transformed into an open-air gallery, featuring large-scale murals, live art battles, and interactive workshops, celebrating contemporary street art and creativity.

events.title: Milburn Art Prize for Landscape: Finalists' Exhibition
events.location: Metcalfe Gallery, Brisbane Institute of Art (BIA)
events.description: View an exhibition of established and emerging artists' interpretations of 'Landscape as a space for creative discovery', showcasing diverse artistic perspectives.

events.title: Ceramic Glazed Paint a Vase workshop
events.description: Participate in a beginner-friendly workshop where you'll paint glazed ceramic vases and take your finished artwork home on the same day, no kiln firing needed.

events.title: Encounters in the Milky Way
events.location: Sir Thomas Brisbane Planetarium, Mt Coot-tha
events.description: An immersive visual presentation designed to introduce concepts of astronomy and the universe through an exploration of the Milky Way, suitable for curious minds.

events.title: Bands in Parks: Twilight Jazz by the River
events.source: Brisbane City Council Bands in Parks
events.description: Enjoy a live outdoor jazz performance as part of the Bands in Parks program, offering a relaxed twilight musical experience by the river.

events.title: Ceramic Paint & Sip Workshop
events.description: Unleash your creativity in a fun, relaxing workshop where you can personalize a ceramic piece while enjoying a glass of wine, suitable for all skill levels.

events.title: Podcasting for Teens (Workshop)
events.description: A creative workshop introducing teenagers to the fundamentals of podcast creation, including storytelling techniques and basic audio production skills, fostering digital media literacy.

events.title: Pure Voice & Guitar - Cantiga
events.description: Experience an intimate live music performance by Cantiga, featuring pure voice and guitar, focusing on artistic value and atmospheric soundscapes.

events.title: What Do You Want In An Intimate Relationship?
events.description: A workshop or discussion focusing on human behavior and personal growth, exploring inner wellbeing and what individuals truly seek in intimate relationships.

events.title: Heart Dance (Dance and Performance Exhibition)
events.description: An ongoing dance and performance exhibition that delves into movement, emotion, and physical expression through contemporary choreography, offering an experimental artistic experience.

events.title: Duck Pond (Reimagined Theatrical Performance)
events.location: Playhouse, Queensland Performing Arts Centre (QPAC), South Brisbane
events.description: A reimagined theatrical performance inspired by 'Swan Lake,' blending physical theatre, dance, and modern interpretation for an experimental and artistically rich experience.

events.title: Eat Slay Zombie (Contemporary Theatre Production)
events.description: A contemporary theatre production that explores dark comedy and survival themes through a stylized stage performance, offering a unique and thought-provoking experience.

events.title: BIA Members 2026 Exhibition
events.location: Metcalfe Gallery, Brisbane Institute of Art (BIA)
events.description: An exhibition showcasing diverse works in drawing, painting, prints, photography, ceramics, and sculpture by members of the Brisbane Institute of Art, with opportunities to purchase art.

events.title: Odessa Mahony-de Vries | 'Unbound'
events.datetime: Mon 11 - Sat 16 May, 10:00 AM - 5:30 PM (M-F), 10:00 AM - 5:00 PM (Sat)
events.description: An art exhibition featuring the works of Odessa Mahony-de Vries, offering a chance to engage with contemporary artistic expressions in a gallery setting.

events.title: Italian Gala
events.location: Concert Hall, Queensland Performing Arts Centre (QPAC), South Brisbane
events.description: A classical music and cultural performance celebrating Italian traditions with a blend of orchestral and vocal works, offering a rich artistic experience.

events.title: THE LAST SHIP
events.description: An acclaimed musical written, composed, and starring Sting, this production explores themes of loss, pride, and community in a shipyard town.

events.title: Sphero Games for Families
events.description: An interactive, tech-based family activity utilizing Sphero robots to introduce concepts of coding, movement, and game-based learning in a fun, hands-on environment.

events.title: Orchestra Corda Spiritus - Mozart
events.source: Brisbane Classical and Chamber Music Meetup Group
events.description: A classical music performance by Orchestra Corda Spiritus, featuring works by Mozart, offering a refined experience for lovers of orchestral music.

events.title: The Drover's Wife – The Opera
events.location: Glasshouse Theatre – Queensland Performing Arts Centre (QPAC), South Brisbane
events.description: An operatic adaptation of the iconic Australian story, merging dramatic stage performance with contemporary musical composition for a unique cultural experience.

events.title: Autumn Fest
events.location: St David's Neighbourhood Centre, Coopers Plains
events.description: A local community autumn celebration featuring seasonal activities, food stalls, and family-friendly entertainment in a relaxed neighbourhood setting.

events.title: Dog Lovers Festival
events.description: A large-scale festival celebrating all things canine, featuring exhibits, demonstrations, and entertainment for dog enthusiasts and families.
